1	/**
2	 * Deposit deadline reminder cron.
3	 *
4	 * Runs every 15 minutes.
5	 * Fires two reminders per booking:
6	 *   - 12h before deposit deadline (if not yet sent)
7	 *   - 4h before deposit deadline (if not yet sent)
8	 *
9	 * "Deposit deadline" = COALESCE(deposit_deadline_override, created_at + deadline_hours * interval '1 hour')
10	 *
11	 * Uses booking columns reminder_12h_sent_at / reminder_4h_sent_at as idempotency flags
12	 * (set by migration 20260421200000_booking_deposit_reminders.sql).
13	 */
14	import type { Logger } from 'pino'
15	import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase'
16	import { logger } from '../lib/logger'
17	import { enqueueJob } from '../lib/queue'
18	
19	// ─── Types ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
20	
21	type ReminderKind = '12h' | '4h'
22	
23	interface ReminderBooking {
24	  id: string
25	  studio_id: string
26	  client_id: string
27	  scheduled_at: string
28	  deposit_cents: number
29	  reminder_12h_sent_at: string | null
30	  reminder_4h_sent_at: string | null
31	  effective_deadline: string
32	  client: {
33	    first_name: string
34	    email: string | null
35	    phone: string | null
36	  } | null
37	  service: {
38	    name: string
39	  } | null
40	  artist: {
41	    display_name: string
42	  } | null
43	  studio: {
44	    name: string
45	  } | null
46	}
47	
48	// ─── Main handler ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
49	
50	export async function runDepositDeadlineReminders(): Promise<void> {
51	  const runLog = logger.child({ cron: 'deposit-deadline-reminders' })
52	  runLog.info('reminders: checking for upcoming deposit deadlines')
53	
54	  try {
55	    const { data: rows, error } = await supabase
56	      .rpc('get_deposit_reminder_bookings')
57	
58	    if (error) {
59	      runLog.error({ err: error }, 'reminders: RPC failed')
60	      return
61	    }
62	
63	    const bookings = (rows ?? []) as ReminderBooking[]
64	
65	    if (bookings.length === 0) {
66	      runLog.info('reminders: no reminders due')
67	      return
68	    }
69	
70	    runLog.info({ count: bookings.length }, 'reminders: processing')
71	
72	    const results = await Promise.allSettled(
73	      bookings.map((booking) => sendReminderForBooking(booking, runLog)),
74	    )
75	
76	    const succeeded = results.filter((r) => r.status === 'fulfilled').length
77	    const failed = results.filter((r) => r.status === 'rejected').length
78	
79	    results.forEach((result, idx) => {
80	      if (result.status === 'rejected') {
81	        runLog.error({ err: result.reason, bookingId: bookings[idx]?.id }, 'reminders: booking reminder failed')
82	      }
83	    })
84	
85	    runLog.info({ succeeded, failed }, 'reminders: run complete')
86	
87	  } catch (err: unknown) {
88	    runLog.error({ err }, 'reminders: unexpected error')
89	  }
90	}
91	
92	// ─── Per-booking reminder logic ───────────────────────────────────────────────
93	
94	async function sendReminderForBooking(booking: ReminderBooking, parentLog: Logger): Promise<void> {
95	  const bookingLog = parentLog.child({ bookingId: booking.id, studioId: booking.studio_id })
96	
97	  const now = Date.now()
98	  const deadlineMs = new Date(booking.effective_deadline).getTime()
99	  const msUntilDeadline = deadlineMs - now
100	
101	  const hoursUntil = msUntilDeadline / (1_000 * 60 * 60)
102	
103	  const needs12h = !booking.reminder_12h_sent_at && hoursUntil <= 12 && hoursUntil > 4
104	  const needs4h = !booking.reminder_4h_sent_at && hoursUntil <= 4 && hoursUntil > 0
105	
106	  if (!needs12h && !needs4h) return
107	
108	  const kind: ReminderKind = needs4h ? '4h' : '12h'
109	  bookingLog.info({ kind, hoursUntil: hoursUntil.toFixed(2) }, 'reminders: sending deposit reminder')
110	
111	  const clientFirstName = booking.client?.first_name ?? 'there'
112	  const studioName = booking.studio?.name ?? 'the studio'
113	  const serviceName = booking.service?.name ?? 'your session'
114	  const artistName = booking.artist?.display_name ?? 'your artist'
115	
116	  const hourLabel = kind === '12h' ? '12 hours' : '4 hours'
117	  const reminderBody =
118	    `Hi ${clientFirstName}, just a reminder: your deposit for ${serviceName} at ${studioName} is due in ${hourLabel}. ` +
119	    `Please pay to keep your slot. Contact us if you have questions.`
120	
121	  const clientEmail = booking.client?.email
122	  const clientPhone = booking.client?.phone
123	
124	  // ── Email reminder ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
125	  if (clientEmail) {
126	    try {
127	      await enqueueJob('send-email', {
128	        to: clientEmail,
129	        template: kind === '12h' ? 'deposit_reminder_12h' : 'deposit_reminder_4h',
130	        data: {
131	          studioName,
132	          clientFirstName,
133	          serviceName,
134	          artistName,
135	          scheduledAt: booking.scheduled_at,
136	          deadlineAt: booking.effective_deadline,
137	        },
138	      })
139	      bookingLog.info({ kind }, 'reminders: email job enqueued')
140	    } catch (err: unknown) {
141	      bookingLog.warn({ err, kind }, 'reminders: email enqueue failed (non-fatal)')
142	    }
143	  }
144	
145	  // ── SMS reminder ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
146	  if (clientPhone) {
147	    try {
148	      const { data: smsCommRow, error: smsInsertErr } = await supabase
149	        .from('client_communications')
150	        .insert({
151	          studio_id: booking.studio_id,
152	          client_id: booking.client_id,
153	          booking_id: booking.id,
154	          channel: 'sms',
155	          direction: 'outbound',
156	          template: kind === '12h' ? 'deposit_reminder_12h' : 'deposit_reminder_4h',
157	          subject: null,
158	          body: reminderBody,
159	          status: 'queued',
160	          metadata: {},
161	        })
162	        .select('id')
163	        .single()
164	
165	      if (smsInsertErr || !smsCommRow) {
166	        bookingLog.warn({ err: smsInsertErr }, 'reminders: SMS comm insert failed')
167	      } else {
168	        await enqueueJob('send-sms', {
169	          commId: smsCommRow.id,
170	          studioId: booking.studio_id,
171	        })
172	        bookingLog.info({ kind, commId: smsCommRow.id }, 'reminders: SMS job enqueued')
173	      }
174	    } catch (err: unknown) {
175	      bookingLog.warn({ err, kind }, 'reminders: SMS enqueue failed (non-fatal)')
176	    }
177	  }
178	
179	  // ── Mark reminder sent ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
180	  const sentAtField = kind === '12h' ? 'reminder_12h_sent_at' : 'reminder_4h_sent_at'
181	  const { error: markErr } = await supabase
182	    .from('bookings')
183	    .update({ [sentAtField]: new Date().toISOString(), updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
184	    .eq('id', booking.id)
185	    .eq('deposit_paid', false)     // only mark if still unpaid (concurrent-safe)
186	    .eq('status', 'pending')
187	
188	  if (markErr) {
189	    bookingLog.warn({ err: markErr, kind }, 'reminders: failed to mark reminder sent (non-fatal — may re-send once)')
190	  } else {
191	    bookingLog.info({ kind }, `reminders: ${kind} reminder marked sent`)
192	  }
193	}
